name: Motor Power out of Bounds
hint: A motor-power command above 100% is outside the actuator range and may be clipped, ignored, or produce unreliable movement.
instruction: Limit motor power to 0–100% for mBot; Codey also permits reverse values down to -100%, so validate the device-specific range before issuing the command.
